'''Valwid Ined''' was a brilliant<ref name="ROUVG" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Geektionary French" /> [[Vobati]] who found work as a [[Forger (profession)|forger]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Ined provided fake transit visas to members of the rebel [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] movement so that they could move through Imperial checkpoints in [[Jedha City]] without issue. The forger was present in Jedha [[City]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> in [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|RO|the events at [[Jedha City]]}}</ref> when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[agent]]s [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] passed Ined in the street shortly before the settlement was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superlaser]]. Ined wore a [[Color|brown]] full-body [[Clothing|suit]] that included a face-covering headpiece.<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Valwid Ined first appeared in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which was released in North America on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="RO" /> The character was not named in the film but received identification in the accompanying reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="ROUVG" /> Concept art of Ined for the film was done by [[Adam Brockbank]].<ref name="ArtOfRO">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Ined was also pictured in early concept art for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' by [[Prog Wang]].<ref name="ArtOfJFO">''[[The Art of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>
